args.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: 2D animation spritesheet, 4 equal columns by 2 equal rows, transparent background. Reference images are Hexy's canonical model and wand hand. Draw EIGHT successive cels of ONE smooth forceful overhead whip attack facing RIGHT, inspired by classic side-scrolling whip action: wind up behind shoulder, elbow leads upward, wrist swings overhead, forward lash, full extension, follow-through, recoil, settle. Keep the EXACT SAME WAND HAND as the reference: her LEFT hand, the FAR ARM whose shoulder is at screen-RIGHT behind her torso. The screen-left/near shoulder arm remains free in all eight frames. NEVER switch the wand to the near arm, never two wands. Body twists at waist and knees, weight transfer, hat and long pink hair trail the motion, visible anticipation and follow-through. Maintain exact face, navy hat with golden star, sailor blouse/red bow, blue pleated skirt, navy boots, black wand/gold star. Flat anime cel art, clean variable dark outlines, minimal shading. All full body frames same head/body size, hip center horizontally centered in each cell, boot soles on equal baselines. Generous cell padding for raised wand; no overlaps between cells; no background, no ribbons, no beams, no motion trails, no text, no labels. Not eight unrelated poses. Far-arm wand continuity is highest priority.

Use case: identity-preserve. Hexy 2D game action animation atlas, 4 equal columns x 2 equal rows, transparent. Exact character/style from reference: pink hair, navy witch hat gold star, sailor white top blue trim red bow, pleated blue skirt, navy boots, black wand with gold star in same FAR left hand. Row ONE: four sequential cels guarding directly overhead: first lifts both forearms, second braces wand HORIZONTALLY over hat, third holds braced overhead watching UP, fourth absorbs a hit from ABOVE with knees bent. Hands must be clearly over her head, defensive shoulders raised; no shield painted. Row TWO: four sequential cels of a magical DOWNWARD air-kick dash: coil both legs in air, forcefully kick a trailing boot UPWARD to push off air, extend other boot downward and tuck torso, follow-through descending feet-first. Hair/hat trail UP from downward acceleration. Facing RIGHT in all frames; keep same character proportions and correct wand hand; intact clothes. Consistent flat cel cartoon shading, clean dark ink edges, full body inside each cell, equal sizes and generous transparent margins, no effects or background, no text. Each row is one coherent animation sequence.

Use case: identity-preserve. Create elemental HIT REACTION sprite atlas of the exact basic red clown in reference, facing LEFT. 4 equal columns by 4 equal rows, transparent. Four sequential cels per row, identical body scale, feet on same baseline, clean cel-cartoon line art with MINIMAL shadows. Row1 ELECTRIC: rigid startled pose, cheeks puff, zigzag hair, blue-yellow electric arcs around body; shock flinch then recovery. Row2 FIRE: exaggerated hot surprise, two small flames on cap/sleeve, soot cheeks, recoils and pats heat away, no injury or gore. Row3 WATER: face squints, body bends backwards from splash, hat flattened dripping, shakes off droplets then recovers. Row4 HONEY: golden sticky goo on hat and mittens, arms stuck together, pulls arms apart with honey strands, bewildered wobble then recovery. Preserve red polka-dot costume, white face, red nose, curly red hair, yellow ruff, red boots and pompom hat. These are the SAME clown with four new reactions, no weapons/machines, no skeleton or new costume. Full bodies each inside its cell, generous gutters, same proportions, no ground/background, no text.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: hand-drawn anime/cartoon PINK SATIN WHIP attack VFX spritesheet, exactly 4 equal columns x 2 equal rows. EIGHT ordered frames of ONE continuous whip swing, each an entire single unbroken ribbon. Important fixed anchor for every cell: ribbon begins at x=15%, y=65% of its cell, thin end attached to unseen wand; all motion occurs mostly to right and ABOVE this anchor. 1 narrow slack curl near anchor. 2 opens overhead into tall arch to right. 3 flowing large loop sweeps forward above anchor. 4 loop unfurls. 5 ribbon snaps almost horizontally far to right, sharp star burst on TIP. 6 recoils in wavy S curve, 7 curls back, 8 slack returning. Rich curved SATIN with visible front and burgundy underside, broad pink blade-like twists, pale cel highlights, dark berry variable outline, tapered forked end. Not a circle drawn on ground, not uniform vector lines, no rings magically appearing, no extra disconnected ribbons, no cut-off shapes. Motion follows whip physics with wide flowing loop then sharp extension. Transparent background and generous margins/gutters, no characters/text. Each cell same scale and fixed anchor.
